create_dqn_agent: create a DQN agent with a network, optimizer, replay buffer, and epsilon-greedy exploration policy
run_dqn_step: run a single environment step that selects an action, accumulates transitions, and learns periodically
build_loss_fn: build a loss function that computes TD errors using batched Q-learning with clipped gradients
test_select_action: test the epsilon-greedy action selection method that samples actions from Q-values with exploration noise
review_update: review the JIT-compiled update function that computes gradients and applies optimizer updates to online network parameters
